   GENERATION AND TRANSMISSION RESOURCES AND RELATED RELIEF IN

                          CONNECTION WITH PROJECT EVEST



     PETITION FOR LATE INTERVENTION AND REQUEST FOR INCLUSION ON

      SERVICE LIST OF THE GULF STATES RENEWABLE ENERGY INDUSTRY

                                       ASSOCIATION



NOW INTO THESE PROCEEDINGS comes the Gulf States Renewable Energy Industry

Association ("GSREIA"), pursuant to Rule 10 of the Louisiana Public Service Commission

Rules of Practice and Procedure, and respectfully files this Petition for Late Intervention and

Request for Inclusion on Service List in the above-captioned proceeding.

I. BACKGROUND OF THE PROCEEDING


The proceeding concerns Entergy Louisiana, LLC’s application for certification and approval

of substantial generation and transmission resources associated with Project Evest and

anticipated large-load growth within Louisiana. The proceeding raises issues concerning
generation adequacy, transmission infrastructure, resource planning, cost allocation,
reliability, economic development, and the future evolution of Louisiana’s electric system.
Project Evest represents one of the most significant projected load-growth and
generation-expansion matters currently before the Commission. The outcome of this
proceeding may materially affect future opportunities for renewable generation resources,
battery energy storage systems, transmission development, competitive procurement practices,
and policies applicable to large—load customers throughout Louisiana.



II. INTEREST OF GSREIA


GSREIA is a regional nonproﬁt trade association whose members include renewable energy

developers, battery storage companies, engineering firms, investors, equipment
manufacturers, technology providers, transmission developers, and other entities engaged in
the development of energy infrastructure throughout Louisiana and the Gulf South. The

outcome of this proceeding may directly affect the interests of GSREIA’s members.



III. STANDARD FOR INTERVENTION


Rule 10 of the Commission’s Rules of Practice and Procedure authorizes intervention by

                                                                      Commission. Intervention
persons whose interests may be affected by a proceeding before the
is appropriate where participation will assist in the development of a complete record and
 where no undue prejudice will result to existing parties.



IV. GOOD CAUSE FOR LATE INTERVENTION


Although the original intervention period has expired, good cause exists for GSREIA’s
participation. This proceeding remains active. GSREIA does not seek to reopen previously
completed procedural matters and accepts the record as it presently exists. No party will be
prejudiced by GSRE1A’s participation, and GSREIA’s involvement will contribute additional
expertise concerning the matters under consideration.

V. UNIQUE CONTRIBUTION TO THE RECORD


GSREIA can provide expertise regarding utility-scale renewable generation, battery energy

storage systems, transmission development, large-load energy strategies, private capital
investment, emerging energy technologies, and infrastructure plamring. These issues are

directly implicated by the application under consideration.

VI. PUBLIC INTEREST CONSIDERATIONS


The issues presented in this proceeding have substantial implications for Louisiana's ability to

attract data centers, advanced manufacturing facilities, artiﬁcial intelligence infrastructure,


hydrogen projects, and other major economic development opportunities. GSREIA’s
participation will assist the Commission in evaluating how renewable energy resources and
emerging infrastructure models may coexist with the Commission’s obligations to ensure
reliable electric service and protect existing customers from unreasonable cost shifts.



VII. NONPROFIT STATUS

GSREIA is organized and operated as a nonprofit trade association. To the extent any filing

fee is required, GSREIA respectfully requests that such fee be waived.



VIII. SERVICE LIST REQUEST


GSREIA respectfully requests that all notices, pleadings, correspondence, discovery, and

other filings in this proceeding be served upon Monika Gerhart, Executive Director

(mgerhart@gsreia.org), and Stephen Wright, Consultant (swright@gsreia.org).

PRAYER FOR RELIEF


WHEREFORE, GSREIA respectfully requests that the Commission grant this Petition for

Late Intervention; admit GSREIA as a full party of record; include GSREIA and its

representatives on the official service list; to the extent any filing fee is required, waive such
fee; and grant such other relief as may be just and proper.
